items.definition:
relating to a synapse
Synaptic connections are crucial for brain function.

very weak or slight
The connection between the two events was tenuous.

relating to the arrangement of the natural and artificial physical features of an area
They studied the topographic map to plan their hike.

relating to the navel or umbilical cord
The baby's umbilical cord was clamped.

mentally unbalanced; deranged
His behavior became increasingly unhinged.

relating to the uterus
Uterine contractions are a sign of labor.

having mixed feelings or contradictory ideas about something or someone
She felt ambivalent about moving to a new city.

active against microbes
Many cleaning products have antimicrobial properties.

relating to ancient Babylon or its empire
The museum displayed ancient Babylonian artifacts.

relating to cattle
The farm specializes in bovine livestock.

(of a tree or shrub) shedding its leaves annually
Oak trees are deciduous, losing their leaves in autumn.

(of a disease or condition) characterized by progressive deterioration
Alzheimer's is a degenerative disease affecting the brain.

excessive, unreasonably high
The hotel charged an exorbitant price for a small room.

relating to feces
The lab test detected fecal matter in the sample.

obviously offensive
It was a flagrant violation of the rules.

consisting of grains; detailed
The report provided granular data on sales.

not alive
Rocks are inanimate objects.

relating to a modified form of liberalism tending to favor free-market capitalism
The government adopted a neoliberal economic policy.

relating to the geological epoch that extended from 2.58 million to 11,700 years ago
Many large mammals lived during the Pleistocene epoch.

Having a healthy red color
His face was ruddy from the cold wind.

not able to be maintained or defended
His argument was logically untenable.

steady or resolute; not wavering
She showed unwavering support for her team.

being truly or very much so
The garden was a veritable jungle.

extremely bad or severe; without pride or dignity
They lived in abject poverty.

able to be used as a basis for legal action; providing a basis for action
The report provided actionable insights for the marketing team.

relating to moods, feelings, and attitudes
The study examined the affective responses of the participants.

severe or strict in manner or attitude
The monk lived an austere life of simplicity.

relating to the colon and rectum
Colorectal cancer screening is important for early detection.

representing a number of different Christian churches
They held an ecumenical service for all faiths.

occurring in episodes
He suffers from episodic memory loss.

cunning or attractive
She gave him a foxy smile.

done at random or without careful judgment
The indiscriminate bombing caused many civilian casualties.

relating to or characteristic of hell or the underworld
The infernal noise from the construction site was unbearable.

relating to metastasis; spreading to other parts of the body
The patient was diagnosed with metastatic cancer.

formed of a single large block of stone; massive and uniform
The company had a monolithic structure, making change difficult.

wicked or criminal
The villain's nefarious plot was foiled.

relating to the last period of the Paleozoic Era
The Permian extinction event was the largest in Earth's history.

relating to or characteristic of a regiment
He wore his regimental uniform with pride.

Unnecessary, especially through being more than enough.
The extra details in the report were superfluous.

Occurring at the same time.
The dancers performed in perfect synchronous movement.

Causing a marked change in someone or something.
The new technology had a transformational impact on the industry.

Relating to or involving translation (e.g., of text, or in physics).
Translational research aims to bridge the gap between basic science and clinical application.

Seeking to harm someone in return for an injury or wrong.
The vengeful spirit haunted the old mansion.

Relating to the adrenal glands.
The adrenal glands produce hormones like adrenaline.

Not friendly or forthcoming; cool and distant.
He remained aloof from the party, observing everyone from a distance.

understood by few; mysterious or secret
The old wizard possessed arcane knowledge.

relating to the skull or cranium
The doctor examined the patient's cranial nerves.

lasting for a very short time
Fame can be an ephemeral thing.

of a person, place, or thing, giving their name to something
The eponymous hero of the novel is a young orphan.

Extremely small; tiny.
The chances of success were minuscule.

relating to the later part of the Stone Age
Archaeologists discovered tools from the Neolithic period.

of the first or highest quality; prime
The restaurant serves primo Italian food.

having or showing the weaknesses or diseases of old age, especially a decline in mental faculties
His grandfather was becoming increasingly senile and forgetful.

involving ignoble actions and motives; dirty or squalid
The newspaper exposed the sordid details of the politician's corruption.

celebrated in story or history; having many stories or levels
The university has a long and storied history of academic excellence.

hot and humid; attractive in a sensual way
The sultry summer evening was perfect for a walk.

relating to or denoting a person who identifies with a gender different from their birth sex
The book provides insights into the experiences of transsexual individuals.

harmed or injured
He was scathed by the harsh criticism, though he tried not to show it.

having or showing great energy or enthusiasm
She was a zealous supporter of the charity.

using force or threats
The government used coercive measures to enforce the new law.

relating to or based on experience
The course offers an experiential learning approach, focusing on practical application.

relating to the words or vocabulary of a language
The study focused on lexical analysis of the text.

deserving reward or praise
Her meritorious service to the community was recognized with an award.

showing hatred, dislike, or mistrust of women
His misogynistic comments were widely condemned.
